newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Aug 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Aug 8.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Friday's electronic version of The Wall Street Journal.
* DuPont agreed to invest $1.7 billion for a 20.0 percent stake in Pioneer Hi-Bred.
* Apple Computer's recent pact with Microsoft does little to resolve the long-term problems that have led to Apple's current condition, industry officials said.
* Citicorp withdrew its $500 million advertising account from three agencies and handed it over to Young & Rubicam.
* Big retailers' July same-store sales rose 6.1 percent on average.
* The FCC moved to drastically cut the cost of international calls from the U.S.
* United Parcel Service and its Teamsters union resumed their contract negotiations, although held fast to their past positions.
* Foundation Health plans to record $405.9 million in pretax charges and costs related to the merger of the two California HMO's that created the company.
* Fisher Scientific agreed to be acquired by Thomas H. Lee for $1.06 billion.
* Mutual fund investors plowed about $23 billion into stock funds in July.
* The Dow Jones Industrials slid 71.31 to 8188, while bonds fell and the dollar was lower.
* Columbia/HCA has decided to turn over key cost records to the government.
* America Online posted strong quarterly growth in revenue and earnings, although accounting changes forced the company to record a loss.
* Analysts said Merrill Lynch, Donaldson Lufkin or PaineWebber would be good acquisition targets for Chase Manhattan.
* Bond prices ended lower Thursday amid late profit-taking.
